source_scope: Reviewed uncommitted worker/wrapper and unchanged helpers are byte-pinned and archived per trial; HEAD alone is not their source identity.

decision.comment: HH_260906 - Separate held-brake micromotion from moving-coast failures and future label representation.
decision.purpose: Measure sensitivity to handbrake while every other commanded setting and all recorded settle/hold samples remain fixed.
decision.same_request: Both arms throttle0 steer0 servicebrake1 reversefalse manualgearfalse; parking adds hand_brake=true. Observed automatic gear is recorded, not forced equal.
decision.continue_rule: Run exactly ABBA once each, checking owned completion and released ports after every trial. Stop remaining launches on any protocol, cleanup, collision or bounded-motion failure; retain partial files and mark unrun cases.
decision.safety_abort: Any observed collision, or planar speed>0.1m/s or net planar displacement>0.5m from spawn at tick>=70 stops that case.
decision.interpretation: Descriptive same-spawn repetitions, not independent routes. Handbrake sensitivity does not prove numerical noise, COM identity or a solution to moving-stop failures.
decision.outputs: All470 native states and6camera observations every native tick; save235 even-tick six-camera JPEG bundles. Record frame-bracketed controls, physics at spawn/settled, acknowledged command journal and pre-camera native journal.
decision.unchanged: No actor pose/velocity injection, physics disabling, model/TF/label/gate edits, training admission or automatic winner/noise-tolerance selection.

revision.comment: HH_260906 - Bind displacement to the requested spawn after preserving the pre-tick uninitialized pose failure; retain the same physical bounds and recording schedule.
revision.previous_outcome: A1 stopped at tick70 because the pre-tick API pose was all zero. All70native states,35camera bundles210JPEGs and70ACKs retained; otherthree arms notrun.
revision.only_changed_code: Use the already computed exact requested actor spawn transform as motion origin. Archive both requested origin and pre-tick observed pose, explicitly flagging the latter as not the baseline.
revision.unchanged: No added ticks, state injection, phase changes, altered controls, weakened0.1m/s or0.5m safety bounds, or simulation/rig changes.
